theorem sure {F} (hc : ∀ j : I, C (F j))
    (h : ∀ j n t, 0<t → tower (law l r F j) n (t,0)=0)
    (hh : ∀ j t, 0<t → F j (t,0)=0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t) (j : I) :
    tower (F j) n (t,0)=0 := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing t j with
  | h n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact hh j t ht
    | succ n =>
      let x := (t,(0:ℝ))
      have he : tower (law l r F j) n x=tower (F (l j)) n x+tower (F (r j)) n x+tower (tangent (F j)) n x := by
        unfold law; rw [addJet ((hc _).add (hc _)) (hc j).tangentC n (show x ∈ side from ht)]; dsimp only; rw [addJet (hc _) (hc _) n (show x∈side from ht)]
      have hv : tangent (tower (F j) n) x=t • tower (F j) (n+1) x := by simp [tangent,x,tower_step]
      have hy := h j n t ht
      change tower (law l r F j) n x=0 at hy
      rw [he, ih n n.lt_succ_self _ ht, ih n n.lt_succ_self _ ht,zero_add,zero_add] at hy
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (smul_eq_zero_iff_right ht.ne').mp (hv.symm.trans hy)
      | succ n =>
        rw [flow_step (hc j) n (show x∈side from ht), lean (hc j) n (fun t h => ih n (by omega) _ h _) t ht,smul_zero,sub_zero,hv] at hy
        exact (smul_eq_zero_iff_right ht.ne').mp hy

proof_context.conclusion: `sure` shows by strong induction on the order, for all labels `j` at once, that `tower (F j) n (t, 0) = 0` for every `n`.

theorem blossoms (h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (A a : ℝ → ℂ) (ha : AnalyticAt ℝ a 0)
    (hv : ∀ x t, inner ℂ (f x) (f t)=A (t-x)) (ht : ∀ n, iteratedDeriv n A 0=iteratedDeriv n a 0)
    (x : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ f x := by
  obtain ⟨C,hc,ρ,r,Hb⟩ := center a 0 ha
  apply builds f h (√C) (ρ/2) (by positivity) (by positivity) _ x
  intro m x
  unfold Power at *
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).1
  have he : ‖iteratedDeriv m f x‖^2 ≤ C*(ρ^(m+m))⁻¹*((m+m).factorial:ℝ) := by
    have he := congr_arg norm (bud f h x x A hv m m)
    simp [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,ht] at he
    rw [he]; exact Hb _
  apply he.trans
  have Hh : (m+m).factorial ≤ 2^(m+m)*m.factorial^2 := by
    calc _ = (m+m).choose m * m.factorial * m.factorial := by rw [← Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (show m≤m+m by omega),Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
         _ ≤ _ := by rw [pow_two,← mul_assoc];gcongr; exact Nat.choose_le_two_pow ..
  calc _ ≤ C * (ρ^(m+m))⁻¹ * (2^(m+m)*(m.factorial:ℝ)^2) := by gcongr; exact_mod_cast Hh
       _ = _ := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow (√C),Real.sq_sqrt hc.le]
        simp only [pow_add,div_pow, inv_div] -- simplified?
        field_simp

proof_context.conclusion: `blossoms` bounds `‖iteratedDeriv m f x‖^2` by the Gram kernel's Cauchy estimate `C ρ^{-2m} (2m)! ≤ C (2/ρ)^{2m} (m!)^2` and concludes `f` analytic.

theorem builds (h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (C ρ : ℝ) (hC : 0<C) (hr : 0<ρ)
    (hh : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedDeriv n f x‖ ≤ Power C ρ n) (x : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ f x := by
  let a := x-ρ/4
  have hx : x∈ Ioo a (a+ρ/2) := by constructor <;> dsimp only [a] <;> linarith
  let u : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ ℝ E := fun n => Tensor.coeff f n a
  have he := groups f h C ρ hC hr hh a x hx
  have hu : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y => u.sum (y-a)) x :=
    ((FormalMultilinearSeries.analyticOnNhd (p := u) _ he.1).comp (f := fun y => y-a)
      (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const))
  exact hu.congr ( (show ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y∈ Ioo a (a+ρ/2) from Ioo_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2) |>.mono (fun i hi => (groups f h C ρ hC hr hh a i hi).2))

proof_context.conclusion: `builds` turns a bound `‖iteratedDeriv n f x‖ ≤ C ρ^{-n} n!` into analyticity by Taylor's remainder, uniformly in `x`.

lemma channel (P : W.Derivatives S) (Y : Collinear W T) (C : commutes W T) (x : Points n) (k b) (K : Ortho.Skew) (p : Fin n → S.Tag)
    (s : ℝ) (hv : Earliest (cast x k b s) a k ∨ Latest (cast x k b s) a k) : AnalyticAt ℝ (angular W T p K ∘ cast x k b) s := by
  let V := Classical.choice (realization H a)
  have ha (i : Fin n → S.Tag) : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (disc i ∘ cast x k b) s := AnalyticAt.contDiffAt
    (hv.elim (first_adv V H W T P Y C _ _ _ _ _) (last_adv V H W T P Y C _ _ _ _ _))
  apply ContDiffAt.analyticAt
  unfold Function.comp angular
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro i hi; apply (ha _).add (ContDiffAt.sum _)
  intro u hu
  have he : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (cast x k b) s := contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_id.smul contDiffAt_const)
  exact ((factor i u K).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp s he).smul (ha _)

proof_context.conclusion: `channel` shows `angular W T p K ∘ cast x k b` is analytic at points where the moving insertion is `Earliest` or `Latest`.
